fields.key: stable identifier used in URL hashes and tests
fields.label: human-readable display name
fields.hbm_gb: HBM capacity per GPU in GB
fields.hbm_bw_gbs: peak HBM bandwidth per GPU in GB/s
fields.ici_bw_gbs: peak inter-chip bandwidth per GPU in GB/s (NVLink bidir, or PCIe for no-NVLink cards). Used in Y_max = F/(B·β) where β = hbm_bw_gbs / ici_bw_gbs
fields.fp16_tflops: peak dense BF16/FP16 tensor TFLOPs (no sparsity)
fields.fp8_tflops: peak dense FP8 tensor TFLOPs; null if hardware has no FP8 path
fields.nvlink: true if multi-GPU TP within node has high-bandwidth interconnect

_sources: NVIDIA datasheets (T4, L4, A10G, A100, H100, H200, all SXM where applicable)
MODEL_SIZING_SCALING_REFERENCE.md §1 (H100 SXM = 9.9e14 FLOPs, 3.35e12 B/s HBM; H200 = 4.8e12 B/s)
MODEL_SIZING_SCALING_REFERENCE.md §6 Y_max derivation — β values: H100 ≈ 3.7, A100 ≈ 3.4, TPU v5e ≈ 8 (book's example)

hardware.label: T4 (g4dn)
hardware.notes: Turing; no hardware FP8 path. Reference for Stage 2 g4dn.xlarge spot work.

hardware.label: L4 (g6)
hardware.notes: Ada Lovelace; FP8 supported. PCIe only — no NVLink even in multi-GPU configs.

hardware.label: A10G (g5)
hardware.notes: Ampere consumer-class tensor cores; no FP8.

hardware.label: A100 40GB (SXM4)
hardware.notes: Ampere; NVLink 3.0 = 600 GB/s bidir within DGX/HGX. No FP8 — Hopper introduced FP8.

hardware.label: A100 80GB (SXM4)
hardware.notes: Same compute as 40GB; doubled HBM lifts the roofline ridge point. NVLink 3.0 = 600 GB/s bidir.

hardware.label: H100 80GB (SXM5)
hardware.notes: Hopper SXM; per reference §1, B_crit ≈ 295 (bf16) / 590 (fp8 weights, bf16 acts). NVLink 4.0 = 900 GB/s bidir → β ≈ 3.7.

hardware.label: H200 141GB (SXM5)
hardware.notes: Same compute as H100, ~43% more HBM and ~43% more bandwidth. Reference §1: B_crit ≈ 205 (bf16). NVLink 4.0 = 900 GB/s bidir → β ≈ 5.3.
